fields.help: Vault entry kind — secret (arbitrary fields) or login (has username/url).
fields.label: Kind

fields.help: Name to save the vault entry under. Must be unique per profile — saving again under the same name overwrites nothing (fails); use vault.secret_get to check first if needed. This value is the same for every item in a batch — running this node against more than one item saves the first and fails on the second (duplicate name), so batches need a per-item-unique name.
fields.label: Name

fields.help: JSON array of item field names whose CURRENT values are encrypted and stored under those same names.
fields.label: Fields To Save (JSON array)

fields.help: Optional username to store alongside the entry (login kind).
fields.label: Username

fields.help: Optional URL to store alongside the entry (login kind).
fields.label: URL

fields.help: Optional free-text notes, encrypted alongside the fields.
fields.label: Notes

fields.help: Item field where the new vault entry id (e.g. sec-001) is written.
fields.label: Output Field
